title: [CI] InternalTestClusterIT testStoppingNodesOneByOne failing

labels.name: :Distributed/Cluster Coordination
labels.description: Cluster formation and cluster state publication, including cluster membership and fault detection.

body:
The failing assertion was introduced recently in #89298 and indicates a bug.

**Reproduces locally?:**
Didn't try
